summary: Iteration 8 — verified the 1.1.0-a change set: MRD shadow-mode engine, commonness read-time block, clamp recording, Closeness inversion fix, Essential shadow/zero-gap edits, copy lint, and rewritten Landing. Backend pytest: 140 pass / 1 pre-existing fail (test_iteration6.py:213 substring match of 'predict' inside the legitimate word 'unpredictable' — not one of the eight banned phrases in the review request). All other iteration_8 verifications green.

minor.issue: Overly-strict substring check: _forbidden_terms() at line 187-193 includes bare 'predict' which matches the legitimate word 'unpredictable' in Essential choosing copy ('unpredictable partners who destabilize your need for security'). Change to whole-word regex (r'\bpredict\b') or drop 'predict' since the review's own banned list is verb-phrase specific and does not include it. Not blocking product.

action_items: Minor: relax the 'predict' substring rule in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py::_forbidden_terms() so it does not flag the legitimate word 'unpredictable'. Use r'\bpredict\b' or drop the bare term (the reviewed banned list is verb-phrase specific).
critical_code_review_comments: services/mrd.py + routes/mirror_v2.py — MRD block correctly persisted at complete_assessment() and only mode/profile/scale_sets/suppressions surface at read; `choosing` remains read-time only. Diagnostics rollup query is authenticated and returns totals/by_gate/by_scale_set — good shape.

services/display.py — STEN_PCT corrected (sten 4=23, sten 7=77) confirmed on the wire; commonness cleanly excludes globals with an explicit `excluded` reason string. NotNormReferenced never surfaced because primaries never trigger it — correct.

composites.py — raw_precise/clamped/clamp_note fields are present on every global with default None; clamp_events collected. Since ui.demo's raw values sit in 5.95-6.95, no live clamp fired — mechanism proven by field presence but a synthetic-primary integration test would strengthen coverage.

report_pdf.py — Closeness relabelling and direction sentence are unambiguous; Essential shadow warning is emitted once (single 'shadow pull' occurrence in the whole doc); zero-gap general note present.

Landing.js — data-testid coverage is thorough on both mobile (hero + sections) and desktop (nav). Pricing tiers explicitly labelled 'NOT YET PURCHASABLE' so honesty guardrail holds. Hero image is static PNG (naturalWidth 1241) — matches the 'real report-page image' requirement.

Test hygiene: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py uses substring `predict` which now collides with product copy 'unpredictable'. The reviewed banned-phrase list is verb-phrase specific; the test should be updated to reflect that.
